dedupe_keys.name: residential energy dataset with evs pv generation and tariff variability dingle peninsula ireland

description: This dataset combines household energy and mobility data from four volunteer households of a pilot energy community on the Dingle Peninsula in Ireland, presented by its authors as the first public dataset joining these metrics for the same homes. Each home has a 2.1 kWp rooftop PV system, a 5 kWh Sonnen battery, a Hyundai Kona Electric, a 7.4 kW Pulsar Plus charger and a Mitsubishi Electric Ecodan air-source heat pump. The data give grid imports and exports and PV production at 30-minute intervals over three years, EV charging sessions and journey logs with start and end times, distance and duration from February 2021 to January 2022, and battery telemetry and heat pump demand for the last six to eight months (mid-2021 to early 2022), with weather data and figure scripts. Coverage: four homes in County Kerry. Access: free on Figshare (version 7, January 2026) with a Scientific Data descriptor. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: four homes only, and battery and heat pump data cover a short window. Simulation uses: household load shifting, battery and EV charging optimisation, and heat pump flexibility models. Related records: HEAPO and the filtered Irish BER dataset.
